```{r}
#| label: setup
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)

weather <- read_csv("data/sarasota-hourly-weather.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  mutate(time = as.POSIXct(time, tz = "America/New_York"))

latest_day <- max(weather$time)
date_range <- paste(
  format(min(weather$time), "%b %-d"),
  "-",
  format(max(weather$time), "%b %-d, %Y")
)
```

## Sarasota weather, hour by hour

This view follows the rhythm of the week: warm afternoons, cooler nights, and the small weather events that make a Florida forecast feel alive.

```{r}
#| label: weather-plot
#| fig-width: 12
#| fig-height: 8
#| fig-cap: "Hourly weather in Sarasota, Florida, during the most recent complete week."

plot_data <- weather |>
  select(time, temperature_f, humidity_percent, precipitation_in, wind_speed_mph) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = -time,
    names_to = "measure",
    values_to = "value"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    measure = factor(
      measure,
      levels = c("temperature_f", "humidity_percent", "precipitation_in", "wind_speed_mph"),
      labels = c("Temperature (°F)", "Relative humidity (%)", "Precipitation (in)", "Wind speed (mph)")
    )
  )

ggplot(plot_data, aes(time, value)) +
  geom_area(
    data = filter(plot_data, measure == "Temperature (°F)"),
    fill = "#f4a261", alpha = 0.28
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(plot_data, measure == "Temperature (°F)"),
    color = "#df6f3f", linewidth = 0.9
  ) +
  geom_col(
    data = filter(plot_data, measure == "Precipitation (in)"),
    fill = "#2a9d8f", alpha = 0.75, width = 3600 * 0.8
  ) +
  geom_line(
    data = filter(plot_data, !measure %in% c("Temperature (°F)", "Precipitation (in)")),
    color = "#287c9e", linewidth = 0.7
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~ measure, ncol = 1, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_x_datetime(date_breaks = "1 day", date_labels = "%a\n%b %-d", expand = c(0.01, 0)) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, subtitle = date_range) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "#fbfaf7", color = NA),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "#fbfaf7", color = NA),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "#e4e8e6", linewidth = 0.35),
    strip.text = element_text(color = "#174c5b", face = "bold", hjust = 0),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "#e8f0ed", color = NA),
    plot.title = element_text(color = "#174c5b", face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(color = "#527078"),
    axis.text = element_text(color = "#527078"),
    plot.margin = margin(12, 18, 12, 18)
  )
```
